title: Honor the advertised DisableEncryption configuration
description:
Review: Astra adversarial review — code simplicity and layout.

## Source locations

- `engine/config.go:7`
- `engine/engine.go:42`
- `frontend/src/components/ConfigEditor.vue:51`

## Evidence

DisableEncryption exists in the persisted/synced Config and is automatically rendered as a toggle by the generic config editor, but Configure never reads it. Repository-wide search found no consumer beyond generated types.

## Reproduction / validation

Toggle Disable Encryption and save; the field round-trips in JSON but the underlying torrent client receives exactly the same encryption settings.

## Impact

An exposed operational setting silently does nothing, undermining the generated-config-as-contract design and complicating diagnosis of peer compatibility.

## Acceptance criteria

Map the field to the intended supported anacrolix crypto policy, or explicitly remove/deprecate the setting and stop exposing it as functional. A focused test asserts the two accepted values produce the documented client policy.

## Confidence

high; exhaustive field-use search

## Completion evidence

DisableEncryption=true now sets anacrolix HeaderObfuscationPolicy to Preferred=false, RequirePreferred=true, requiring plaintext peer transport. False retains the upstream default Preferred=true, RequirePreferred=false (encryption preferred with plaintext fallback). The field comment and generated type document this contract.

Focused race test captures real ClientConfig policies across false → true → false client transitions. Full go test -race ./... passes; embedded Go build and generated-type checks pass.

Live browser: changed Disable Encryption to true and saved into a fresh scratch directory, then submitted public Big Buck Bunny. Synced config confirmed true and torrent transferred 51986432 bytes (18.8%). Toggled false and saved while active; same infohash remained started and transferred 6748443 bytes after rebind/recheck at observation. Original config restored and test torrent/scratch removed.
